name: usage-pacer
description: Shows session-limit usage in the status line, warns once at 80% and 95% of each window, and can run a /handoff command before the 5h limit in the session you are working in

sonnetSubagentsAbove.title: Sonnet subagents above (%)
sonnetSubagentsAbove.description: When usage of any window is above this percent, general-purpose subagents with no model of their own run on sonnet. 0 turns it off.

handoffAt.title: Auto-handoff at 5h usage (%)
handoffAt.description: When the 5-hour window reaches this percent, run your /handoff command once in the session you are actively working in. Needs a /handoff command or skill of your own. 0 turns it off.
